Multi-Day Retreats

Stepping away to remember our roots. These immersions are designed for deep integration — where "man softens man" through direct experience with the land, ancient wisdom, and the fire of devotion.

Wild Roots Immersions

Our retreats take men out of the ordinary and into the essential. Days in nature, nights around fire, and the kind of deep work that can only happen when you step fully away from daily life.

  • 2 to 5 day immersive retreats in natural settings
  • Ceremony, ritual, and rites of passage
  • Somatic and breathwork experiences
  • Council work and deep personal inquiry
  • Integration support before and after

Coming up

Check our current schedule or reach out directly to be notified of the next retreat offering. These fill quickly — we recommend joining our community first to stay in the loop.
